crossRefs.note: Yahweh God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”
For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it…
You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’
Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account?”
But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning…
While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have…

people.name: Abel
people.line: Adam and Eve's second son, killed by Cain

people.name: Cain
people.line: Adam and Eve's firstborn son, killed his brother Abel

translations.web: Yahweh said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”
translations.bsb: And the LORD said to Cain, “Where is your brother Abel?” “I do not know!” he answered. “Am I my brother’s keeper?”
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: am I my brother's keeper?
